meta.title: Vendor-onboarding-v2 stage updates need the onboarding permission
gaps: the plan has the vendor send PATCH /trade/{{tradeId}}, but the supplier app may not call PATCH /trade/:id (it is not on agribid_website's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
The setup cannot explicitly create a vendor-onboarding-v2 stage or a user with a specifically absent onboarding permission; it covers the closest available vendor stage-update authorization case.
the case reads as “it is accepted”, but the plan checks “it is refused”
warnings: error code 455 is not in en-IN.yml (or the backend checkout is missing) — the message cannot be checked

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the request that updates the round, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
